title: Claim
description: One of articulating's two non-assembling primitives. A claim IS a JSON Schema 2020-12 document — a type-stating unit, not an opaque label. The primitives live at the meta-level of the carrier: JSON is the carrier, JSON Schema is JSON's self-description, and articulating constitutes its slots in that self-description rather than below it. The meta-schema self-validates, so the recursion has a principled floor. The claim-vs-token distinction is positional (slot 1 of the utterance pair); both primitives are type-stating units, differing only by the role their slot plays under articulating's two-sided act.
